free_time.title: Free Time
free_time.body:
This is my first of the 'Shorts' category. I made this category for whenever I just want to share my thoughts on a situation I'm experiencing, and don't feel like making a long or well-written explanation. I won't even worry too much with correct collocations and such.

Having free time sounds like heaven when seen from afar. What I mean by that is that yesterday, thinking of having free time was the greatest thing ever. Now, having nothing to do until at least the first week of October, I can't help but wish I had something to do... It's like I don't have a guide specifiying where to go now, and even though I know I'll sort it out in a few minutes, it's boring.
